description: Machine-readable commitments contract for the Ashton & Price 2026-07-09 routine-settings grid. tests/customer-commitments.test.ts parses the LIVE customer.yaml + routine-grid.yaml and asserts these commitments still hold. Any change to the live outbound_roster forces a same-PR bump to the outbound_roster list below, so a roster change is always a reviewed diff.

external_send_never_autonomous.why: The letter's permanent cap: opposing counsel and the court always take a person's send. No persona on this seat may author external_send: autonomous.

invariants.outbound_roster_classes_note: firm_staff added 2026-08-22 (ss-console#2546). The letter's roster is the firm's own client and records vendor, and those two keep their own graduatable ceilings unchanged. The third class carries no client mail: it types SMD's own operations desk (team@smd.services) so an operations request the firm makes of SMD can be passed on instead of sitting as a held draft. Outbound classification only; the address is not on scope.inbound_allow_from on either seat, so nothing claiming to come from it is trusted.

settings_placeholders.note: PLACEHOLDER(christa) values on pilot-smokeball await the firm's real answers (letter section 'What we need back from you'). They are permitted on this staging seat but MUST NEVER appear under operator/customers/ashton-price/ (the client go-live gate, enforced by test (d)).

enforcement_floor.note: The tool-to-action-class map that pins payments_* / trust-ledger / create_matter as COMMITMENT-class lives overlay-side (shared/action_classes.py), outside this repo, so there is no ss-side BANNED_TOOLS list to assert against. The ss-reachable floor is trust_ceiling.enforce(): a COMMITMENT action is never allowed without explicit current-turn approval, even at ceiling=autonomous. Test (e) source-guards that invariant against silent removal and asserts no persona authors commitment: autonomous.
